acceptance_signals: The task binds resolved alignment journey mcpj-f565c4f45c9149588cece61d2f7afcd3 and the human-selected user-host no-model comparison direction without treating alignment as task admission.
Read-only preflight confirms the retained runtime, remote-free clone, original consumer, Starter worktree, user Codex configuration, and command identities before any host launch.

The comparison records which AgentGov executable and configuration layer the user-host Codex process resolves, using only process-local environment or trust inputs and without persistent configuration change.
At most one separately approved user-host Codex startup is attempted, and it stops before turn/start, prompt submission, model interaction, tool invocation, repair, retry, or second launch.
The evidence distinguishes command-resolution, Codex-home, TUI or equivalent host startup, and required-MCP readiness as far as normalized events permit.
If startup would require or creates user-local state beyond unavoidable bounded thread metadata, the exact state is disclosed and the task stops without cleanup or expansion.

No raw prompt, response, transcript, source content, credential, private data, user or temporary absolute path, thread identity, installation identity, or unbounded host log is retained in repository evidence.
The original AIRBNB repository, retained clone content, retained runtime, Starter source, user Codex configuration, credentials, Git state, remotes, and external systems remain unchanged.
The task and repository checks, cumulative scope reconciliation, task JSON parsing, bounded privacy scans, baseline test suite, and git diff check pass or truthfully report preserved excluded state.
The task stops before repair, launcher pinning, model turn, governed replay, dependency download, cleanup, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or broader activation.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-eafb17c86d8540c4831999ba94557f0f and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Run one bounded no-model comparison of the retained AgentGov runtime and remote-free AIRBNB binding through user-host Codex command resolution and TUI or equivalent startup. Stop before turn/start or any model interaction, make no repair or persistent configuration change, and retain only sanitized repository evidence.

items: A user-host Codex startup may create local thread metadata or attempt background network access even when no model turn is requested.
A TUI startup could advance to model interaction unless the exact process is observed and stopped before turn/start.
Process-local PATH or worktree trust inputs could resolve a different launcher or configuration layer than intended.
Reading broad host logs could expose prompts, credentials, source content, private paths, or unrelated sessions.
The retained runtime or clone may have drifted and must fail closed if recorded identities no longer match.
A likely repair may become apparent, but diagnosis grants no repair or launcher-pinning authority.
The working tree contains prior-task and user-owned excluded changes that must be preserved.
Reviewed assumption: The retained Python runtime and remote-free AIRBNB clone still exist.
Reviewed assumption: The current Codex executable can expose command resolution or host startup evidence before any model turn.
Reviewed assumption: Exact processes and configuration hashes can be observed without persisting trust or editing user configuration.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the earlier TUI initialize failure is reproducible in the current user-host environment.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the user-host Codex home or TUI path resolves a different AgentGov launcher than the bounded App Server path.
Reviewed unknown: Whether unavoidable user-local thread metadata can be cleanly distinguished without reading unrelated session content.
Reviewed unknown: Whether background plugin or model transport attempts can be prevented entirely during user-host startup.

title: Compare the user-host Codex-to-AgentGov startup boundary without a model turn
